title: Tariffs
savedDemo: Tariff saved (demo — this browser only, no hub touched).
removeZoneBody: Its hours stay unpriced until another zone takes them.
coverageGaps: Hours without a zone: {spans}. Energy then is not priced — assign a zone or a default zone.
coverageOverlaps: {spans}: “{winner}” applies — the hub ranks it above “{losers}”.
netMeteringExplain: A zone’s selling price is the money you get per exported kWh. The credit ratio is the share of exported kWh credited against future purchases (a kWh credit).
coverageGapsFallback: Hours without their own zone: {spans} — the default zone “{zone}” applies.
zoneShadowed: Zone “{zone}” never applies — “{by}” overrides it. Change its hours or days.
zoneShadowedNone: Zone “{zone}” never applies. Change its hours or days.
defaultZoneHint: Applies in hours no other zone takes
priorityHint: Where zones overlap, the more important one applies: critical peak → holiday → weekend → evening peak → morning peak → night → late evening → day.
planTypeMismatch: Plan type “{type}” but {n} zones are on. The hub prices by the zones — change the plan type so the label matches.
ratioUnused: Every zone has its own selling price — the selling ratio is not used. Only zones without a price use it.
expired: The plan expired ({date}) — the hub keeps pricing with it; check the tariff is still right.
